content.text: {"openings":[{"text":"Pip the young dragon clutched a sealed message and bounced beside Nia’s kite table. “Aunt Ember must see my dragon drawing!” he said. Nia eyed the {phrase:kite.tail_material} on the bright kite and held up a feather. “First, let’s discover what this little mark actually says.”","when":[{"key":"message.mark","op":"eq","value":"dragon","at":"initial"},{"key":"mailbox.audience","op":"eq","value":"private","at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Pip had a sealed message, a daring idea, and absolutely no patience. Nia had a kite and a strong preference for {phrase:nia.safe_preference}. Near Aunt Ember’s mailbox, they spotted a gathering. “If everyone is watching,” said Pip, “perhaps this message needs a sky-sized hello!”","when":[{"key":"mailbox.audience","op":"eq","value":"public","at":"initial"}]},{"text":"A tiny mark on Pip’s sealed message looked like a dragon, but Nia leaned closer. “That may not mean what you think,” she said. The kite waited on the table, its {phrase:kite.tail_material} tail drooping like a sleepy noodle, while Aunt Ember’s mailbox stood quietly beyond the hill.","when":[{"key":"message.mark","op":"eq","value":"weather","at":"initial"},{"key":"mailbox.audience","op":"eq","value":"private","at":"initial"}]}],"scenes":[{"scene":"inspect_message","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Nia bent over the sealed message and discovered a tiny weather mark stamped beneath the flap. “It says weather,” she announced. Pip blinked. His dragon drawing suddenly felt as if it had wandered into the wrong story.","when":[{"key":"nia.knows.message.mark","op":"ne","value":null,"at":"after"},{"key":"message.mark","op":"eq","value":"weather","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Nia squinted at the seal and discovered a dragon mark, curled horns and all. “There’s your dragon,” she said. Pip puffed a pleased little smoke ring.","when":[{"key":"nia.knows.message.mark","op":"ne","value":null,"at":"after"},{"key":"message.mark","op":"eq","value":"dragon","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Nia found a gathering mark on the message: three dots beneath a fluttering pennant. “This one is meant for people together,” she said, and Pip’s eyes grew round.","when":[{"key":"nia.knows.message.mark","op":"ne","value":null,"at":"after"},{"key":"message.mark","op":"eq","value":"gathering","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"inspect_audience","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Nia peered past the workshop and discovered a quiet mailbox with nobody nearby. “Private,” she whispered. Pip hugged the message close.","when":[{"key":"nia.knows.mailbox.audience","op":"eq","value":"private","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Nia looked toward Aunt Ember’s mailbox and discovered children gathering beside it, waving paper kites. “Public!” she cried. Pip’s tail gave an excited thump.","when":[{"key":"nia.knows.mailbox.audience","op":"eq","value":"public","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_mark","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Nia shared the mark’s meaning, and Pip listened with one smoky eyebrow raised.","when":[{"key":"pip.knows.message.mark","op":"ne","value":null,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_audience","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Nia told Pip who waited by the mailbox; Pip glanced from the quiet path to the lively crowd.","when":[{"key":"pip.knows.mailbox.audience","op":"ne","value":null,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"choose_thread","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"For the private flight, Nia chose blue thread. Pip poked it. “A tail so skinny it needs a magnifying glass?” “A tail that lets the kite rise,” said Nia.","when":[{"key":"kite.selected_tail","op":"eq","value":"thread","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"choose_feather","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Nia chose the soft feather for the private flight. Pip held it up. “A bird borrowed its best idea!” The feather tickled his nose, and he sneezed a tiny spark.","when":[{"key":"kite.selected_tail","op":"eq","value":"feather","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"choose_ribbon","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"For the children’s gathering, Pip chose the red ribbon. “Grand swoop!” he declared. Nia tied a knot and watched the ribbon curl like a very fancy dragon moustache.","when":[{"key":"kite.selected_tail","op":"eq","value":"ribbon","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"hand_kite_to_pip","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Nia placed the bright kite in Pip’s claws. He held it as solemnly as a royal pancake.","when":[{"key":"kite.owner","op":"eq","value":"pip","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"hand_message_to_nia","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Pip handed Nia the sealed message. “You found the mark,” he said. “You help me give it the right words.”","when":[{"key":"message.owner","op":"eq","value":"nia","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"rewrite_dragon","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Because the mailbox was private and the mark was dragon, Nia and Pip made a bright dragon drawing. Pip added three whiskers. “One for courage, one for sparkle, and one for sneezing,” he said.","when":[{"key":"message.text_kind","op":"eq","value":"dragon_drawing","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"rewrite_weather","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The weather mark changed their plan. Pip traded his dragon drawing for a useful weather note, complete with a sun, two clouds, and one enormous raindrop wearing boots.","when":[{"key":"message.text_kind","op":"eq","value":"weather_note","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"rewrite_sky","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"With children gathered nearby, the message became a sky cheer. Pip drew a grinning dragon; Nia added bright letters underneath: “HELLO, CLOUD FRIENDS!”","when":[{"key":"message.text_kind","op":"eq","value":"sky_cheer","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"attach_tail","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Together they tied the chosen {phrase:kite.tail_material} to the kite. The bright paper wings shivered, as if the kite had just heard a marvelous secret.","when":[{"key":"kite.tail_attached","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tuck_message","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Nia tucked the finished message into the kite’s little pocket, and Pip patted it twice.","when":[{"key":"message.tucked","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"invite_shared_flight","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip looked at the children, then at Nia. “Will you fly with me?” Nia smiled and took the blue thread. “Only if the kite gets a proper bow.” It did.","when":[{"key":"nia.agrees.public_flight","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"launch_kite","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"At the quiet hill, Pip ran. The kite lifted toward Aunt Ember’s private mailbox, carrying its tucked message. The thread hummed, and Pip’s feet nearly forgot to touch the ground.","when":[{"key":"kite.airborne","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"mailbox.audience","op":"eq","value":"private","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"launch_public_kite","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip and Nia ran together. The red ribbon pulled the kite into a grand, low swoop above the children. Everyone cheered before the kite had even finished its first loop.","when":[{"key":"kite.airborne","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"mailbox.audience","op":"eq","value":"public","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"deliver_private","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The private kite reached Aunt Ember’s mailbox. A green reply flag lifted. Pip’s dragon drawing had arrived, and the quiet path suddenly seemed full of invisible wings.","when":[{"key":"mailbox.reply","op":"eq","value":"green_flag","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The kite delivered its weather note to the private mailbox. A silver sun appeared on the reply flag. Pip stared at it, then drew a second sun in the air with one glowing claw.","when":[{"key":"mailbox.reply","op":"eq","value":"silver_sun","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"deliver_weather","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The kite carried the weather note safely, even in its low wobbling flight. Aunt Ember’s mailbox answered with a silver sun. Nia smiled as the kite bobbed like an honest little boat.","when":[{"key":"mailbox.reply","op":"eq","value":"silver_sun","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"deliver_public","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The sky cheer sailed above the gathering. The children shouted it back, and Aunt Ember’s mailbox flashed a cheerful reply. The red ribbon curled around the blue thread like a dancing dragon.","when":[{"key":"mailbox.reply","op":"eq","value":"cheer","at":"after"}]}]}],"endings":[{"text":"The feather-tail kite trembled above the hill like a tiny bird waving. Below, Pip’s grin shone brighter than the quiet mailbox’s green flag.","when":[{"key":"mailbox.reply","op":"eq","value":"green_flag","at":"after"},{"key":"kite.tail_material","op":"eq","value":"feather","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The blue thread quivered, the green reply flag lifted, and Pip’s private dragon drawing went on its way. Nia tucked the leftover spark into her pocket.","when":[{"key":"mailbox.reply","op":"eq","value":"green_flag","at":"after"},{"key":"kite.tail_material","op":"eq","value":"thread","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The weather kite wobbled low and true while a silver sun gleamed on Aunt Ember’s reply. Nia smiled; even the kite seemed pleased with its honest little wobble.","when":[{"key":"mailbox.reply","op":"eq","value":"silver_sun","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Above the children, the red ribbon curled around the blue thread like a dancing dragon. Their cheers tugged the sky cheer higher and higher.","when":[{"key":"mailbox.reply","op":"eq","value":"cheer","at":"after"}]}],"lexicon":[{"key":"kite.tail_material","value":"none","text":"no tail"},{"key":"kite.tail_material","value":"thread","text":"blue thread"},{"key":"kite.tail_material","value":"ribbon","text":"red ribbon"},{"key":"kite.tail_material","value":"feather","text":"soft feather"},{"key":"nia.safe_preference","value":"thread","text":"blue thread"},{"key":"nia.safe_preference","value":"feather","text":"soft feather"}]}
